title: sorbus aria subsp. mougeotii
intro: Sorbus aria subsp. mougeotii, commonly known as Whitebeam, is a subspecies of mountain ash native to the Pyrenees and other mountainous regions in Europe. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus aria subsp. mougeotii include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can aid in protecting against oxidative stress and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
